name: Yuvraaj Hygiene Products Limited
about: Yuvraaj Hygiene Products Limited manufactures and supplies hygiene and cleaning products in India. It operates through Household Cleaning Products; Warehousing Storage Products; and Insecticide Products segments. The company offers scrub pads, floor cleaners, toilet cleaners, and kitchen hygiene solutions. In addition, it offers insecticide products, including mosquito repellents, insect sprays, and pest control solutions; and warehousing and storage solutions, such as warehouse cleaning solutions, storage racks, dividers, and accessories. Yuvraaj Hygiene Products Limited is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
